Ne bismo rekli da ovdje ima redundantnih podataka, ali dostupni podaci potvrđuju što je poznato o smještaju putnika na palubama Titanica:

The Titanic was designed to enforce a rigid social hierarchy, with passengers segregated strictly by their ticket class.
• First Class (The Upper Decks): First-class passengers occupied the most luxurious areas of the ship, primarily on A, B, and C Decks. They had exclusive access to the Boat Deck promenades, the gym, the squash court (on G Deck), and the Titanic Grand Staircase. Their cabins were closest to the lifeboats.
• Second Class (Middle to Aft Decks): Second-class accommodations were located mainly toward the back (aft) of the ship, spanning D, E, and F Decks. They had their own dedicated smoking room, library, and dining saloon.
• Third Class / Steerage (Lower Decks & Outer Ends): Third-class passengers were housed in the least desirable sections, subject to the noise and vibration of the propellers and engines. They were split by gender: single men slept in the bow (front) on D through G Decks, while single women and families were housed in the stern (back).

Uočimo da faker podržava generiranje muških i ženskih imena.

fake.name_male(), fake.name_female()

('Karlo Miklečić', 'Zvonko Keleković')



def izmisli_ime(sex):
  """ Izmisli ime, ali u skladu sa spolom (sex). """
  if sex == "female":
    return fake.name_female()
  else:
    return fake.name_male()

izmisli_ime("female")
